title: Modern Data Stack: Microsoft Fabric Real-Time Analytics vs Snowflake Iceberg Catalogs
summary: Deep dive into Delta Parquet on OneLake, open Iceberg metadata management, and enterprise capacity cost modeling across multi-cloud lakehouses.
hosts: Host A (Data Platform Architect) & Host B (Analytics Engineering Lead)

chapters.title: 1. Microsoft Fabric OneLake Delta Parquet Architecture
2. Apache Iceberg Metadata Scaling on S3/Blob Storage
3. Cost Comparison: Fabric F-SKU vs Snowflake Warehouses

ai.title: Draft-Verification Speculative Decoding & KV-Cache Offloading
bullets: Draft-Verifier Pipeline: A lightweight 1B draft model proposes token sequences in parallel while a 70B target model verifies them in a single forward pass.
2.5x Inference Speedup: Accelerates generation latency without altering model output distribution or accuracy.
PagedAttention Memory Optimization: Offloads inactive KV-cache blocks to system RAM, doubling batch concurrency.
ai.interview_framing: Explain the mechanics of speculative decoding to interviewers, emphasizing how it circumvents memory bandwidth bottlenecks in large language model inference.

cloud.title: AWS Graviton4 ARM Migration & Ephemeral Spot Fleet Orchestration
bullets: Price-Performance Efficiency: Graviton4 processors provide 30% higher compute performance and 20% lower power consumption for microservices.
Multi-Arch Container Builds: Builds dual-architecture AMD64/ARM64 container images using Docker Buildx and GitHub Actions.
Spot Interruption Tolerance: Integrates AWS Node Termination Handler to drain pods gracefully within the 2-minute spot warning window.
cloud.interview_framing: Discuss how migrating container workloads to ARM64 architecture delivers immediate double-digit cloud cost savings while improving server density.

data.title: Microsoft Fabric OneLake vs Snowflake Apache Iceberg & Polaris
bullets: Open Storage Unification: Evaluates open Delta Parquet in OneLake against Apache Iceberg metadata catalogs across cross-engine analytics.
Multi-Engine Compute Freedom: Snowflake, Apache Spark, and Trino query identical data files concurrently without vendor lock-in.
Centralized Access Control: Polaris catalog enforces uniform column-level and row-level security across heterogeneous compute engines.
data.interview_framing: In data architecture interviews, compare the governance and cost trade-offs between Microsoft Fabric Direct Lake mode and Snowflake managed Iceberg tables.

sec.title: OIDC Identity Federation & Elimination of Long-Lived AWS Secrets
bullets: GitHub Actions OIDC: Exchanges short-lived GitHub tokens for temporary AWS IAM session credentials, eradicating stored AWS access keys.
Least-Privilege Scoping: Scopes IAM role trust policies strictly to specific repository branches and environments.
Automated Credential Revocation: Automatically invalidates session tokens after 15 minutes of inactivity.
sec.interview_framing: Detail how OIDC token federation eliminates the risk of static CI/CD secret leaks and simplifies compliance audits across cloud environments.

sources.title: GitHub Actions OpenID Connect with AWS

devops.title: Automated Network Latency Injection & Chaos Mesh in Kubernetes
bullets: Proactive Failure Verification: Simulates cross-region WAN packet loss, pod restarts, and DNS outages during business hours.
SLO Verification: Validates that circuit breakers and retry budgets prevent cascading outages during database failovers.
Automated Rollback Triggers: Integrates Argo Rollouts with Prometheus metrics to halt deployments when error rates exceed 0.5%.
devops.interview_framing: Explain how running controlled chaos experiments in staging and production builds confidence in automated failover mechanisms.

arch.title: Apache Kafka Tiered Storage & Remote S3 Segment Offloading
bullets: Local Disk Decoupling: Retains active segments on fast local NVMe SSDs while offloading historical log segments to Amazon S3.
Infinite Retention at 80% Lower Cost: Allows years of event history to remain queryable via standard Kafka consumer APIs.
Instant Broker Recovery: Reduces partition rebalance times from hours to minutes because new brokers stream data directly from object storage.
arch.interview_framing: Explain how Kafka Tiered Storage transforms message brokers into unified event stores without incurring massive local disk storage bills.

finops.title: S3 Intelligent-Tiering & Automated Object Lifecycle Archival
bullets: Automated Access Monitoring: Moves unaccessed data objects between Frequent, Infrequent, and Archive Instant Access tiers with zero retrieval fees.
Lifecycle Rule Pruning: Automatically expires non-current object versions and incomplete multipart uploads after 7 days.
Predictive Cloud Storage Forecasting: Tracks storage growth rates using S3 Storage Lens analytics dashboards.
finops.interview_framing: Show how implementing automated storage tiering and multipart cleanup rules reduces petabyte-scale cloud storage bills by up to 40%.

gov.title: Automated Cloud Custodian Policy Enforcement & Non-Compliance Remediation
bullets: Real-Time Event Triggers: Scans AWS CloudTrail and Azure Activity Logs to detect unencrypted storage buckets within 3 seconds of creation.
Automated Remediation: Automatically applies encryption tags, disables public access, and alerts the security operations team.
Compliance Drift Reports: Generates weekly SOC2 and ISO 27001 evidence reports directly from declarative YAML policies.
gov.interview_framing: Highlight how policy-as-code with Cloud Custodian automates continuous compliance and eliminates manual audit preparation effort.

flashcards.question: Why are enterprise teams migrating from proprietary data warehouse tables to Apache Iceberg metadata catalogs?
flashcards.answer: Iceberg eliminates vendor lock-in by storing data in open Parquet format on customer cloud storage, allowing multiple compute engines (Snowflake, Spark, Trino) to query identical data with ACID transactions.

full_articles.data:
Title: Open Table Formats: Delta Lake vs Apache Iceberg
Source: Microsoft & Snowflake Architecture (2026)

Section 1: The Multi-Engine Lakehouse Architecture.
Modern data platforms store petabyte-scale data in customer-owned cloud object storage (Azure Blob, AWS S3) formatted as open Parquet files. Apache Iceberg manages snapshot isolation and schema evolution, enabling concurrent access from Snowflake, Apache Spark, and DuckDB without data duplication.
